kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أكتشف (form VIII)
# أَكْتَشِفُ (ʔaktašifu) /ʔak.ta.ʃi.fu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# أُكْتَشَفُ (ʔuktašafu) /ʔuk.ta.ʃa.fu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# أَكْتَشِفَ (ʔaktašifa) /ʔak.ta.ʃi.fa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِكْتَشَفَ (iktašafa)
# أُكْتَشَفَ (ʔuktašafa) /ʔuk.ta.ʃa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
